verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites are adorned in light woods, timeless furnishings and locally inspired photography, with Duxiana mattresses and Red Flower bathroom amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Adorned in light woods, timeless furnishings, and locally-inspired photography, our hotel rooms & suites in Charlottesville, VA feature luxurious Duxiana mattresses and bespoke Red Flower bathroom amenities.

verified_facts.text: Many rooms have private terraces that overlook the golf course.

verified_facts.text: The spa sits at the edge of woodland, with soft interior lighting and natural finishes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled into the edge of woodland and featuring soft interior lighting and natural finishes, the spa’s design encourages tranquility and recovery.

verified_facts.text: The spa's serenity room offers weighted blankets, guided meditation tools and freshly steeped herbal teas.
